scope.design: Sources typechecked and inputs frozen before automatic measurements. Previous law-family knowledge informed human source choices; this is an independent replication corpus, not an unbiased generalisation estimate.
scope.selection: Ordinary balanced compilation. Evaluation sources are compiler inputs; evaluation calls/results/timings are never selection inputs. No forced selection or manual workload supplied.
scope.evaluation: Eight partial pure kernels including two controls; 128 total cells, 96 nonempty cells. Fixed equal program/size/distribution weighting. Empty/duplicate cases retained outside the headline.
scope.attribution: Before/after machinery at the complete catalogue; within after machinery, remove/add the same six genuine E1 template objects (two reusable schemes). Other canonical knowledge is held fixed.
scope.timing: Eleven randomised interleaved rounds of complete trusted JavaScript calls and full output consumption. Separate process-high-water memory observations are coarse diagnostics, not allocation counts.
scope.policy: Report every regression. Do not tune planner/probe policy or laws using these evaluation outcomes. Add new laws in another epoch with separate validation data.
